reviews.author: Bob Clark
reviews.text: Couldn't be happier. Impressed with the amount of options when ordering. When installed, the fit and finish was second to none. The crew was awesome — working through the 109 degree heat they didn't take any shortcuts and kept me informed on the progress. I highly recommend this business. Thank you very much.

reviews.author: Ken Creamer
reviews.text: Extremely happy about my building. Well done and price very competitive to a wood building that I would have had to go get, constructed and painted myself. Everything included in the project and I just stood and watched till the end. Extremely happy that I went for the 6 foot sliding door.

reviews.author: Glen Cooke
reviews.text: Today was our third project with Quality Metal Carports. First was a 14x30 building with two roll up doors and an entry door, then a 20x22 carport, and today we added another 22 feet to that carport. Piper took great care to ensure that our addition was well planned to match exactly and fit perfectly to the existing structure. Then the install crew today did a great job at making a few adjustments so that the project came out perfect, as though it had all been done together. Everyone I've dealt with during all three projects have been great! The materials they use are high quality.

reviews.author: Nathan Wyrick
reviews.text: Juan and crew came on time, very professional, did an amazing job. They went above and beyond my expectations.

reviews.author: D. Moore
reviews.text: I am very happy with my new metal building. I filled out a request online, and Piper called me back right away to answer all of my questions. I went out to their facility just to see the buildings myself, and the manager Gabriel and Piper took great care of me.

reviews.author: Shyanne Stratton
reviews.text: Amazing people to work with! Very efficient, effective and prompt with their work. Very accommodating and understanding in tough situations.

reviews.author: Paul Lopez
reviews.text: Best team to work with, they make the process smooth and quick. A kind lady named Gladis was very attentive with my questions and made sure all my questions were well answered. 10/10 would work with them again.

reviews.author: Bob Pierce
reviews.text: Great service throughout the entire process. Piper was great in helping us figure out what we needed. The build team was very good and left the site as clean as when they arrived. Very satisfied.

reviews.author: Tom Maddux
reviews.text: Juan and his crew did an amazing job today! The entire crew was courteous and very professional. I would recommend them to anybody.

reviews.author: Jim Carey
reviews.text: I had Quality Metal Carports come out to build an 18'x20' storage shed in my backyard. The guys showed up and immediately began to work. There were 4 guys who quickly unloaded the parts and pieces and carried them from our driveway to the build site.

reviews.author: Steve
reviews.text: Great company! Piper and the team were really responsive and made some corrections on the fly that made the installation flawless. Thank you.

reviews.author: Vicki Wood
reviews.text: The guys came with the building and started putting it together. Very efficient and professional. Thank you. I love my new shop.

reviews.author: Paul Randolph
reviews.text: Juan, Jose and Abraham did a great, fast job — worked long and hard in some not-so-great wind.

reviews.author: Aftab Gill
reviews.text: Ezra did an excellent job, completed on time, and I am very satisfied with his work.

reviews.author: Don Betts
reviews.text: I'm very happy with the product. The installer, Ezra, was very good and professional.

reviews.author: Clinton Gubler
reviews.text: Jorge Rojas is so cool. Very professional, very kind, and does very good work.

reviews.author: Chuy Contreras
reviews.text: Very nice people to work with. Juan and his team did a great job!

reviews.author: Michael Barcellos
reviews.text: They did a very professional job, clean and quick. Definitely will use them again, thank you.

reviews.author: BARCELATA WOOD WORKS INC
reviews.text: Professional company and amazing quality craftsmanship.

reviews.author: Jose Jarvis
reviews.text: Nice receptionist, quality work, great price range.

reviews.author: TheRaceking56
reviews.text: These guys & gals are the best. Gladys was a real pro to work with. Craftsmanship second to none. Thank you!

reviews.author: Sean Harris
reviews.text: The crew was very good — they really did a great job! The building is very nice and went up very fast. I love my new shop.

reviews.author: Esdras Fierro
reviews.text: The best place to get a deal on metal buildings — clean, good service, and quality jobs in California.

reviews.author: Richard Gomez
reviews.text: Good company, great service, even better people.
